name: Daly City
seo_title: Christmas Events for Kids in Daly City, CA 2026
seo_desc: Kids' Christmas in Daly City, CA: Frosty Snow Fest, library holiday crafts, a toy giveaway and the Dickens Christmas Fair at the Cow Palace.
lede: Daly City keeps Christmas close to home, with a city snow day at Serramonte Center, craft nights at the public library and toy drives for neighbors, plus the Great Dickens Christmas Fair on the San Francisco border.
celebrates: The City of Daly City Department of Recreation Services and Serramonte Center team up for Frosty Snow Fest, a free evening of real snow, holiday inflatables, cookie decorating and face painting. The Daly City Public Library runs Bring On The Holidays, a series of craft workshops that starts with parol making in October and continues with Make The Holidays Bright at Bayshore Library, where families decorate cookies, make tote bags and watch a magician. Families who bring an unwrapped gift to Frosty Snow Fest support Operation Santa Claus. Neighbors also hold toy giveaways, such as the PIT Christmas Giveaway at Bayshore Elementary.
lastyear: Daly City's winter event has moved around. In 2023 the city ran Frosty-Fest Winter Wonderland at Westlake Park on Lake Merced Boulevard with almost 150 inflatables. In 2024 it became Frosty Snow Fest at Serramonte Center on a Saturday evening in early December, from 4 to 7 pm, and Serramonte Center has now announced that the event is coming back on Saturday, December 5, 2026, with the same hours. The city's holiday tree lighting at City Hall was a livestream on Facebook in 2020.
facts: Daly City is named for businessman and landowner John Donald Daly and was incorporated on March 22, 1911. Its nickname is Gateway to the Peninsula, and it had 104,901 residents at the 2020 census. The Cow Palace arena grounds straddle the border with San Francisco and host the Grand National Rodeo, Horse and Stock Show. The arena has also hosted Beatles concerts and early NBA Finals games for the Warriors, and it is the home of the Great Dickens Christmas Fair each season.
trains: Daly City is easy to reach by train from San Francisco. Daly City station is the end of the line for BART's Green and Blue lines, and Colma station sits right beside the city limits. From downtown San Francisco you can pair a Daly City outing with a ride on a historic cable car or streetcar, and the city's neighbors in San Francisco keep two small railway museums open year round.

kidfact: Daly City is named for a man named John Donald Daly, and people call it the Gateway to the Peninsula because it is the first city south of San Francisco.
faq: Where can kids see snow in Daly City at Christmas?

Frosty Snow Fest at Serramonte Center has real snow for play. The city's Recreation Services department and Serramonte Center host it in the first floor parking structure, and families who bring an unwrapped toy for Operation Santa Claus are entered in a prize drawing.
Are there free holiday crafts in Daly City?

Yes. The Daly City Public Library's Make The Holidays Bright at Bayshore Library offers cookie decorating, tote bags and gift wrap crafts, and the library says it is free with no registration required.
Is the Great Dickens Christmas Fair in Daly City?
The fair is held at the Cow Palace, whose grounds straddle the Daly City and San Francisco border. It already has its own page on Rally Takes the Train.
How do I get to Daly City without a car?
BART's Green and Blue lines end at Daly City station, and Colma station is beside the city limits, so families can come from San Francisco by train.
Can I donate toys in Daly City?
Frosty Snow Fest collects unwrapped gifts for Operation Santa Claus, and local groups run their own toy drives and giveaways.
